assumptions.statement: The submitted site and key-area polygons are provisional rough constraints supplied for generation, visualization and intake review; they are not official planning boundaries.
assumptions.impact: All area values and ratios are reproducible only against the submitted temporary geometry and must not be used as statutory, approval, parcel, investment or engineering evidence. Replace the polygons and recalculate every dependent layer and metric when official geometry is supplied.

assumptions.statement: ODbL-attributed OSM streets and building footprints are used as low-contrast morphology context, while M/A/P intervention fields are presentation-only shapes aligned to that texture.
assumptions.impact: Neither the OSM context nor the intervention fields establish parcels, road redlines, ownership, legal public access, existing land use, statutory controls or implementation geometry. Formal proposal GeoJSON and metrics remain unchanged.

assumptions.statement: Railway heritage, open innovation and public life are a historical thread, operating mechanism and everyday spatial network across all three focus areas, not three coincident functional zones.
assumptions.impact: Figures must distinguish these lenses from taskbook key-area extents and land-use categories. AI is treated as an optional service layer after spatial, access, human-fallback and governance review.

assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: The package can be reviewed as an AI-generated conceptual design using submitted provisional constraints; statutory controls and implementation conclusions still require official data and professional confirmation.

assumptions.statement: A verified pedestrian, cycle, street, crossing, station-entrance and public-transport network baseline has not yet been collected for the design area.
assumptions.impact: ROAD-001 is a conceptual design marker rather than evidence of a continuous route linking all three key areas. Network coverage, detour, station access and automobile-dependence claims remain unknown until official or rights-cleared network data are processed.

assumptions.statement: No anonymized, time-stamped public-life survey has yet measured pedestrian and cycle flow, staying activities, seating use, active frontages, shade, accessibility or crossing delay.
assumptions.impact: The participant cannot conduct on-site fieldwork. Licensed open data may select future observation locations and diagnose network or land-cover proxies, but the proposal must not claim observed vitality, safety, comfort or public-space performance before a local professional or cleared community partner completes the declared protocol.

assumptions.statement: Parcel uses, ground-floor uses, entrances, opening hours, building age, condition, vacancy and retain-renovate-new-build status are not available at a reliable site scale.
assumptions.impact: Mixed-use, short-block, active-edge and incremental-renewal metrics remain unknown. Current conceptual land-use bands and the single submitted building footprint cannot be treated as an existing-conditions inventory or used to assign retain, renovate, demolish or new-build decisions.

assumptions.statement: The three AI-prefixed key-area names are retained from the taskbook as scope labels; they do not establish existing land use or require every spatial task to contain an AI device or program.
assumptions.impact: Key-area design must first state the ordinary urban role—heritage, access, public life, community service, green space or incremental renewal. AI-enabled services remain optional, reversible layers subject to evidence, human fallback and pause conditions.

assumptions.statement: Renewal difficulty cannot be classified at parcel or building level without existing-use, ownership, lease, age, condition, structure, vacancy, heritage, fire-safety, contamination, municipal-capacity and operating-continuity evidence.
assumptions.impact: The proposal applies a light-to-heavy sequence only: operations and interface repair, adaptive reuse and small retrofit, cautious addition, then conditional reconstruction. No reconstruction extent, demolition quantity or building-level retain-renovate decision is claimed in the current version.

assumptions.statement: OSM, remote-sensing, open-statistics and other external datasets are candidate background sources only until publisher, retrieval date, license, coverage, coordinate reference system, transformation and limitations are recorded.
assumptions.impact: External data may support discovery and reproducible analysis after review, but cannot be promoted into official boundaries, road redlines, statutory controls, ownership or implementation facts.

assumptions.statement: This submission is being developed remotely without participant field access. Network, morphology, mapped-service and land-cover evidence will therefore be separated from observed public-life evidence.
assumptions.impact: Open-data proxy metrics may become known only with a reproducible artifact, license, query, raw SHA-256, CRS, transformation and limitation record. Public-life counts, perceived comfort, active frontage, accessibility compliance and current access conditions remain unknown until independently observed on site.
